title: Drift: access granted outside Privilege
lede: Someone changes a platform by hand. The nightly reconcile reads the platform and the receipts, and flags the difference. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Drift finding: unrecorded, elevated or missing

steps.title: Grant by hand
steps.what: An administrator adds a collaborator, a role or a privilege directly on the platform. Privilege was not asked and has no receipt.

steps.title: Read the platform
steps.what: Every night (02:00 on the lab clock, or when you press the button) the reconcile reads what each platform actually holds.

steps.title: Read the receipts
steps.what: It reads what Privilege says it granted, with the highest live level for each person and resource.

steps.title: Flag the difference
steps.what: Access with no receipt is unrecorded, more access than the receipts justify is elevated, a live receipt with no access is missing, and less access than a live receipt justifies is reduced.

steps.title: Revoke on request
steps.what: An unrecorded or elevated finding can be removed from the platform. The reaper never does this by itself: the access was never a grant.
